finding: Overall effects are positive, but Novara centre estimates are near zero or negative; this is heterogeneity, not a demonstrated full reversal across every stratum.
Primary contrasts are patient-level. Cohort-level results must not be used to infer that every patient deteriorates.
Public ICU/sepsis cohorts are selected clinical samples; selection mechanisms cannot be reconstructed from available metadata.
Antibiotics, nutrition, severity and outcome are unavailable, so conditioning/collider structures cannot be assessed.
No diagnostic sensitivity, specificity, PPV or NPV claim is made.
Participants were not selected by extreme microbiome displacement, but baseline-anchored change without an equivalent clinical control cannot establish disease-specific progression.
Only 30 of 116 patients with a depth-qualified T0 had complete T0/T1/T2, and 24 entered the date-clean primary analysis.
Multiple geometries and sensitivities were examined. These are robustness checks, not independent discoveries; no multiplicity-adjusted discovery claim is warranted.
The historical addendum says 5/2 while executed code used 20/3. Directional results are robust, but local files are not immutable public preregistration.
All cohorts are observational secondary analyses; ecological displacement cannot be described as caused by sepsis or treatment.
Temporal sampling establishes order but does not separate disease evolution from treatment, nutrition or other time-varying exposures.
